conditions.text: Construction of any external walls (including cladding) or roofs to any building subject of this permission shall not take place until details and samples of all external walling, cladding and roofing materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Samples shall be made available on site prior to the commencement of building works, for inspection by the Local Planning Authority which shall be notified in writing of their availability. The building works shall be constructed from the materials thereby approved.

conditions.summary: Full details of solar/photovoltaic panels to be approved before installation
conditions.text: The installation of any solar/photovoltaics panels subject of this permission shall not take place until full details (specification, design and cross-section) of the proposed solar/photovoltaics panels have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Opening hours restricted to 0900–2100
conditions.text: The opening hours for the use hereby permitted shall be restricted to between 0900 hours and 2100 hours.

conditions.summary: Noise attenuation measures from approved noise impact study to be installed before first use
conditions.text: Prior to the first use of the development hereby approved the noise attenuation limits and mitigation measures (in particular the facade construction requirements detailed at part 4.5.2), recommended within the approved noise impact study (Ref RP 230315), received on 24.06.2024, shall be fully installed and implemented. These measures should thereafter be retained as such.

conditions.summary: Details of proposed plant equipment to be approved before first use
conditions.text: Prior to the first commencement of the use details (including plans) of the proposed plant equipment shall be submitted to and be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Cycle/motorcycle parking to be provided before occupation
conditions.text: Development shall not be occupied until the approved cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities have been provided. The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Vehicle areas to be fully laid out, surfaced and drained before occupation
conditions.text: Development shall not be occupied until all areas shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles, including roads, footpaths, cycle tracks, loading and servicing areas and vehicle parking space have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that loose materials and surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points to be provided before occupation
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until the approved Electric Vehicle Charging Points, cable enabled spaces and associated infrastructure have been provided. The facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained as approved for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Soft landscaping details to be submitted and approved before occupation
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall not occupied until full details of soft landscape works, including an implementation programme, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Soft landscape works shall include (a) planting plans (b) written specifications (including soil depths, cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment) and (c) schedules of plants noting species, planting sizes and proposed numbers/densities. All soft landscaping works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details, approved implementation programme and British Standard BS 4428:1989 Code of Practice for General Landscape Operations.

conditions.summary: South-west side elevation window to be obscure glazed for neighbouring privacy
conditions.text: The proposed new window within the south-west side elevation of the main building (serving the vinyl cutting and lathe room), shall be obscure glazed, and retained as such thereafter.

conditions.summary: Cross-section drawing of mezzanine floor levels to be approved before installation
conditions.text: The proposed mezzanine floor shall not be installed until a cross-section drawing showing the relationship between ground and first floor levels has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

applications.address: Saville Works 23 Shafton Lane Holbeck Leeds LS11 9RE
applications.description: Change of use from existing offices and warehouse to 7 residential apartments; associated internal and external alterations including dormer windows; replacement windows and doors, upgraded fire escape to rear

conditions.summary: Development to commence within three years of permission
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Imposed pursuant to the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

conditions.summary: Development to be carried out in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above.

For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

conditions.summary: Sound insulation scheme to protect future and adjoining occupiers
conditions.text:
No development of the site shall take place until full details of a sound insulation scheme designed to protect future occupiers and the occupants of adjoining properties from noise emitted from within the premises shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The flats hereby approved shall not be occupied until the approved sound insulation scheme has been completed and shall be retained thereafter.

In the interests of residential amenity in accordance with the adopted Core Strategy Policy P10 and Leeds UDP Review (2006) Policy GP5.

conditions.summary: Sound attenuation measures per Noise Impact Assessment ref: 2208241NR
conditions.text:
The sound attenuation measures as recommended within Noise Impact Assessment ref: 2208241NR, dated 27/09/2024 shall be fully implemented and completed prior to occupation of the flats hereby approved. These works shall be maintained and retained for the lifetime of the development.

In the interests of neighbouring amenity.

conditions.summary: Details of doors, windows (with reveals) and dormers to be approved
conditions.text:
Notwithstanding the details shown on the plans hereby approved, no development shall take place until full details of doors, windows, which shall be set back into a reveal, and dormers have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained for the lifetime of the development.

In the interests of amenity.

conditions.summary: Statement of construction practice (routing, mud prevention, dust control)
conditions.text: Development shall not commence until a statement of construction practice has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the statement of construction practice shall include full details of: a) the construction vehicle routing, means of access, location of site compound, storage and parking (including workforce parking), means of loading and unloading of all contractors' plant, equipment, materials and vehicles and associated traffic management measures. b) methods to prevent mud, grit and dirt being carried on to the public highway from the development hereby approved. c) measures to control the emissions of dust and dirt during construction. d) how the statement of construction practice will be made publicly available by the developer. The approved details shall be implemented at the commencement of works on site and shall thereafter be retained and employed until completion of the works on site.

conditions.summary: Cycle/motorcycle parking details to be submitted and approved
conditions.text:
Notwithstanding the approved details, works above the ground floor slab level shall not commence until full details of cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

In the interests of highway safety and promoting sustainable travel opportunities.

conditions.summary: Servicing Management Plan including bin storage, collection and cycle parking
conditions.text:
Development shall not be occupied until a Servicing Management Plan (including timescales) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, detailing how bins will be stored, accessed and collected and cycle parking showing 7 bays and how these will also be accessed. The plan shall be fully implemented, and the development thereafter operated in accordance with the approved timescales.

To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Phase I Desk Study and, if required, Phase II Investigation and Remediation Strategy
conditions.text: Development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Phase I Desk Study has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority and: (a) Where the approved Phase I Desk Study indicates that intrusive investigation is necessary, development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Phase II Site Investigation Report has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority; (b) Where remediation measures are shown to be necessary in the Phase I/Phase II Reports and/or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Remediation Strategy demonstrating how the site will be made suitable for the intended use has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Remediation Strategy shall include a programme for all works and for the provision of Verification Reports.

conditions.summary: Contingency procedure for unexpected contamination during remediation
conditions.text: If remediation is unable to proceed in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy, or where significant unexpected contamination is encountered, or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately and operations on the affected part of the site shall cease. An amended or new Remediation Strategy and/or Soil Importation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any further remediation works which shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the revised approved Strategy. Prior to the site being brought into use, where significant unexpected contamination is not encountered, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing of such.

conditions.summary: Remediation works to be carried out per approved strategy; Verification Report required
conditions.text:
Remediation works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy. On completion of those works, the Verification Report(s) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the approved programme. The site or phase of a site shall not be brought into use until such time as all verification information has been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that the remediation works are fully implemented as agreed and the site has been demonstrated to be 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

Prior to planting, the location, tree specification, planting methodology and aftercare to ensure establishment shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason - In the interests of visual amenity.

conditions.summary: Replacement tree planting (1:3 ratio) where trees lost to temporary drop-off facility
conditions.text:
Where trees are lost as a result of the provision of a temporary drop off facility (adjacent to the Old Medical School building) through the discharge of planning condition 43, then within 18 months of the full opening of the permitted adults and children's healthcare facility, replacement trees to a ratio of 1 lost to 3 replacement shall be planted in the location indicated edged blue on Drawing LGI001-PWA-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-90007-P01. Prior to planting, the location, tree specification, planting methodology and aftercare to ensure establishment, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In the interests of visual amenity.

conditions.summary: Development to begin within three years of permission date

The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Imposed pursuant to the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

conditions.summary: Development to be carried out in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above.

For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

conditions.summary: Operational hours limited to 07:00–19:00 Monday to Sunday including Bank Holidays
conditions.text:
The use hereby permitted shall be limited to operational hours between 07:00 and 19:00 Monday to Sunday, inclusive of Bank Holidays.

In the interests of amenity

conditions.summary: Open storage use restricted to specified materials and goods only
conditions.text:
The proposed open storage use permitted shall be limited to the storage of the following materials and goods within the site,
- Tools and machinery
- Vehicles and trailers, including caravans
- Building Materials (including but not limited to aggregates, bricks, tiles, masonry, timber, cladding)
- Pallets (both loaded and unloaded)
- Non-hazardous agricultural materials
- Portakabin/Welfare Units
- Steel Stockholders

In the interest of amenity and noise prevention

conditions.summary: Prohibition on storage of scaffolding anywhere within the site
conditions.text:
The use hereby permitted does not include provision for the storage of scaffolding. Scaffolding shall not be stored anywhere within the site as this is identified as a significant potential noise generator by the LPA.

In the interests of amenity

conditions.summary: Vehicle areas to be laid out, surfaced and drained prior to occupation
conditions.text:
Development shall not be occupied until all areas shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles, including roads, footpaths, cycle tracks, loading and servicing areas and vehicle parking space have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that loose materials and surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter.

To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Approved noise protection scheme (ref NIA-11530-24-11734 V3) to be implemented prior to occupation
conditions.text:
The approved noise protection scheme, ref: NIA-11530-24-11734 V3 submitted 15.11.2024, shall be implemented in full prior to the occupation of any dwelling and shall be retained thereafter.

In the interests of residential amenity.

conditions.summary: Plant and machinery noise not to exceed background noise level (L90) per BS4142:2014
conditions.text:
Plant and machinery operated from the site shall limit noise to a level no higher than the existing background noise level (L90) when measured at noise sensitive premises, with the measurements and assessment made in accordance with BS4142:2014. The rating level shall include the addition of any character corrections as appropriate. If the character is unknown at the design stage or cannot be evidenced then a penalty of 5dB should be applied to take into account of potential corrections.

In the interests of residential amenity.

conditions.summary: Music or amplified sound including tannoy systems not to be audible at site boundary
conditions.text:
Any music or amplified sound including tannoy systems used shall not be audible from any point on the site boundary.

In the interests of residential amenity.

applications.address: Garden Centre Pool Road Otley LS21 1DY
applications.description: Demolition of existing warehouse and outbuilding; erection of building comprising new children's play facility and warehouse; creation of outdoor play space and landscaping; new car park layout

conditions.summary: Development to begin within three years of permission date
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Imposed pursuant to the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above.

For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

conditions.summary: External walling and roofing materials to be submitted and approved
conditions.text:
Construction of external walls and roofs to any building subject of this permission shall not take place until details and samples of all external walling and roofing materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Samples shall be made available on site prior to the commencement of building works, for inspection by the Local Planning Authority which shall be notified in writing of their availability. The building works shall be constructed from the materials thereby approved.

In the interests of visual amenity.

conditions.summary: Tree and vegetation protection measures during construction (BS5837)
conditions.text: a) No works shall commence (including any demolition, site clearance, ground works or drainage etc.) until all existing trees, hedges and vegetation shown to be retained on the approved plans are fully safeguarded by protective fencing and ground protection in accordance with approved plans and the specifications and the provisions of British Standard 5837 (2012) Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. b) Evidence shall be submitted that confirms that a qualified Arboriculturist/competent person has been appointed to carry out Arboricultural monitoring/supervision. c) Seven days written notice shall be given to the Local Planning Authority that the protection measures are in place prior to demolition/approved works commencing. d) No equipment, machinery or materials shall be used, stored or burnt within any protected area.

conditions.summary: Full hard and soft landscape works details to be submitted prior to occupation
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works, including a dated implementation programme (inclusive of any phasing), have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Hard landscape works shall include (a) proposed finished levels and/or contours, (b) boundary details, means of enclosure and retaining structures, (c) car parking layouts, (d) other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas, (e) hard surfacing areas, (f) minor artefacts and structures, (g) existing trees with Root Protection Areas (RPAs) and all other retained vegetation. Soft landscape works shall include (h) planting plans, (i) written specifications, (j) schedules of plants, (k) drainage proposals. All hard and soft landscaping works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Replacement planting within five years if trees/hedges/shrubs die or are removed
conditions.text:
If within a period of five years from the date of the planting of any tree/hedge/shrub that tree/hedge/shrub, or any replacement, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective, another tree/hedge/shrub of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted in the same location as soon as reasonably possible and no later than the first available planting season, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure maintenance of a healthy landscape scheme.

conditions.summary: Protection of retained trees/hedges/bushes for five years from occupation
conditions.text: Within 5 years of occupation, no approved retained tree/hedge/bushes shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed nor any tree be pruned, topped or lopped or suffer root severance (other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars) without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority (LPA). In the event of any such works being carried out without having first sought and received written approval from the LPA the following actions shall be undertaken: a) Within one month of the removal, uprooting or loss of any retained tree a replacement planting scheme shall be submitted... b) Within one month of a pruning, topping, lopping or root damage of a retained tree, a Professional Arboricultural Report shall be submitted... c) Within one month of removal, uprooting, damage or loss of any retained bush/bushes details of replacement planting shall be submitted... d) Within one month of removal of any retained hedges details of replacement planting shall be submitted.

conditions.summary: Written confirmation of integral bat roosting and bird nesting features prior to first use
conditions.text:
Prior to first use written confirmation of integral bat roosting and/or integral bird nesting features will be submitted to the local planning authority. This should include photographs of features in-situ and a written statement that all features have been installed as per the agreed specifications and locations.

Reason: to maintain and enhance biodiversity in accordance with Core Strategy Policy G9, NPPF, and BS 42020:2013

conditions.summary: Vehicle areas laid out, surfaced and drained prior to occupation
conditions.text:
Development shall not be occupied until all areas shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles, including roads, footpaths, cycle tracks, loading and servicing areas and vehicle parking space have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that loose materials and surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter.

To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Statement of construction practice required prior to commencement
conditions.text: Development shall not commence until a statement of construction practice has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the statement of construction practice shall include full details of: a) the construction vehicle routing, means of access, location of site compound, storage and parking, means of loading and unloading and associated traffic management measures. b) methods to prevent mud, grit and dirt being carried on to the public highway. c) measures to control the emissions of dust and dirt during construction. d) how the statement of construction practice will be made publicly available by the developer. The approved details shall be implemented at the commencement of works on site and shall thereafter be retained and employed until completion of the works on site.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points to be provided prior to first occupation
conditions.text:
The Electric Vehicle Charging Points, cable enabled spaces and associated infrastructure shown on the approved plans shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development, retained and maintained thereafter as approved for the lifetime of the development.

In the interest of promoting low carbon transport.

conditions.summary: Bin store details to be submitted and approved prior to occupation
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details for the provision of bin stores (including siting, materials and means of enclosure) and (where applicable) storage of wastes and access for their collection shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved measures shall be implemented in full before the use commences and shall be retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

To ensure adequate measures for the storage and collection of wastes are put in place.

conditions.summary: Surface water drainage scheme to be submitted and approved prior to commencement
conditions.text:
No development shall commence until a scheme detailing surface water drainage works has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved scheme before the development is brought into use, or as set out in the approved phasing details.

The surface water scheme forms an integral part of the overall design of the development and failure to provide an appropriate scheme would be harmful to interests of flood prevention and sustainable drainage.

conditions.summary: Music and amplified sound not to be audible at site boundary
conditions.text:
Any music or amplified sound including tannoy systems used shall not be audible from any point on the site boundary.

In the interests of residential amenity.

conditions.summary: Plant and machinery noise limit at noise sensitive premises (BS4142:2014)
conditions.text:
Plant and machinery operated from the site shall limit noise to a level no higher than the existing background noise level (L90) when measured at noise sensitive premises, with the measurements and assessment made in accordance with BS4142:2014. The rating level shall include the addition of any character corrections as appropriate. If the character is unknown at the design stage or cannot be evidenced then a penalty of 5dB should be applied to take into account of potential corrections.

In the interests of residential amenity.

conditions.summary: Children's play facility restricted to specified hours of use
conditions.text:
The hours of use of the approved children's play facility shall be restricted to 9am to 6pm Monday to Saturday and 9.30am to 4pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays with up to 8 occurrences a year where ad hoc activities and/or events are restricted to 8pm.

In the interests of residential amenity.

conditions.summary: Phase I Desk Study and contamination investigations required prior to commencement
conditions.text:
Development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Phase I Desk Study has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority and: (a) Where the approved Phase I Desk Study indicates that intrusive investigation is necessary, development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Phase II Site Investigation Report has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority; (b) Where remediation measures are shown to be necessary, development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Remediation Strategy demonstrating how the site will be made suitable for the intended use has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that the presence of contamination is identified, risks assessed and proposed remediation works are agreed in order to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Notification and revised remediation strategy if unexpected contamination encountered
conditions.text:
If remediation is unable to proceed in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy, or where significant unexpected contamination is encountered, or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately and operations on the affected part of the site shall cease. An amended or new Remediation Strategy and/or Soil Importation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any further remediation works which shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the revised approved Strategy.

To ensure that any necessary remediation works are identified to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Remediation works to be carried out and verified in accordance with approved strategy
conditions.text:
Remediation works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy. On completion of those works, the Verification Report(s) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the approved programme. The site or phase of a site shall not be brought into use until such time as all verification information has been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that the remediation works are fully implemented as agreed and the site has been demonstrated to be 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

applications.address: Container Base Valley Farm Way Stourton Leeds LS10 1SE

conditions.summary: Boundary treatments in accordance with approved drawings
conditions.text:
The boundary treatments to be erected shall be in accordance with the approved details as shown on Drwg. No. 5048-CA-00-XX-DR-A-09301 Rev PL18 (Proposed Boundary Treatments) before the land/buildings to which they relate are occupied and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

In the interests of protecting the amenities of the locality.

conditions.summary: Electric vehicle charging points laid out prior to occupation
conditions.text:
Prior to occupation of the unit to which the charging facilities relate, the Electric Vehicle Charging Points will be laid out in accordance with approved Drwg. No. 5048-CA-01-XX-DR-A-09411 Rev PL15 (Unit A EV Charging Points), Drwg. No. 5048-CA-02-XX-DR-A-09421 Rev PL13 (Unit B EV Charging Points) and Drwg. No. 5048-CA-03-XX-DR-A-09431 Rev PL14 (Unit C EV Charging Points) and shall comprise a 11kW charge points. The approved facilities shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.

In the interest of promoting low carbon transport.

conditions.summary: Existing gated accesses to Units A and C restricted to HGV exit-only
conditions.text:
The existing gated accesses to the site from Valley Farm Road, as identified in Drwg. No. 5048-CA-00-XX-DR-A-01051 Rev PL24 (Site Layout as Proposed), shall be used to provide exit only access. The accesses shall be electronically controlled from the permitted gatehouses so as to only permit an exit of HGV traffic from Plot A and Plot C for the lifetime of the development, in accordance with the measures and controls contained within the Access Strategy section of the approved Highways Technical Note JN2300-0013.2 April 2023.

For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of highway safety.

applications.address: Leeds Valley Park Savannah Way Rothwell Leeds LS10 1AB

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above. The remainder of the site shall continue to accord with those Plans and Specifications listed on the decision notice for application 20/07516/FU.
For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

conditions.summary: External finishes – louvres, ducts, substation, fences and compounds
conditions.text:
The louvres, doors and windows approved under this permission shall be of similar appearance to existing openings / apertures. The external flues/ducts shall be finished in a medium/light grey colour (eg RAL 240 80 05) sufficient to minimise their visual appearance. The new substation shall be finished in a colour similar to the existing substation, and the revised / relocated external compound fence shall match the existing. The new waste and ASHP compound fences / screening shall be finished in a medium/light grey colour sufficient to minimise their visual appearance.
In the interests of visual amenity.

conditions.summary: Contaminated land and coal legacy – compliance with previously agreed details
conditions.text:
Any new development that requires ground works and/or the importation of soil shall be carried out in accordance with the contaminated land and coal legacy details agreed under conditions 6 and 8 of application 20/07516/FU (23/02842/COND).
In the interests of land stability and public safety.

conditions.summary: Access road maintenance for lifetime of development
conditions.text:
The access road agreed under condition 10 of application 20/07516/FU (22/01045/COND) shall maintained to an appropriate standard thereafter for the lifetime of the development.
To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Forward visibility splay to be laid out and retained
conditions.text:
The access hereby approved shall not be brought into use until the area of land shown on the approved plans has been laid out as a forward visibility splay to adoptable standards. The visibility splay shall be retained clear of all obstructions for the lifetime of the development.
To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Vehicle areas surfaced and drained before building brought into use
conditions.text:
No building shall be brought into use until all associated areas as shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles in connection with that building have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter.
To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Electric vehicle charging points – compliance with previously approved details
conditions.text:
The EVCP points agreed under condition 14 of application 20/07516/FU (22/01045/COND) shall be shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of each respective building and thereafter retained in accordance with the approved details.
In the interests of promoting sustainable travel opportunities.

conditions.summary: Separate foul and surface water drainage systems
conditions.text:
The site shall be developed with separate systems of drainage for foul and surface water on and off site.
In the interest of satisfactory and sustainable drainage.

conditions.summary: Site drainage details to be installed prior to first occupation
conditions.text:
The site drainage details agreed under condition 16 of application 20/07516/FU (22/01045/COND shall be installed prior to the first occupation of each building and thereafter retained and maintained to an appropriate standard.
In the interests of flood prevention and pollution control.

conditions.summary: External walling and roofing materials to be approved before superstructure works
conditions.text:
Construction of external walls or superstructure to any building above slab level subject of this permission shall not take place until details and samples of all external walling and roofing materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Samples shall be made available on site prior to the commencement of building works, for inspection by the Local Planning Authority which shall be notified in writing of their availability. The building works shall be constructed from the materials thereby approved and retained thereafter.

In the interests of visual amenity.

conditions.summary: Coal mining risk – intrusive investigation and remediation before above-ground works
conditions.text:
No above ground development shall commence until:
a) a scheme of intrusive investigations has been carried out on site to establish the risks posed to the development by past shallow coal mining activity; and
b) any remediation works and/or mitigation measures to address land instability arising from coal mining legacy, as may be necessary, have been implemented on site: and
c) a signed statement or declaration prepared by a suitably competent person confirming that the site is, or has been made, safe and stable for the approved development.
has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The intrusive site investigations and remedial works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and authoritative UK guidance on working in a High Coal Risk Area for Development.

In the interest of public safety as the site is in a High Coal Risk area for Development.

conditions.summary: Contamination – Remediation Strategy to be approved before development commences
conditions.text:
Development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Remediation Strategy demonstrating how the site will be made suitable for the intended use has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Remediation Strategy shall include a programme for all works and for the provision of Verification Reports.

To ensure that the presence of contamination is identified, risks assessed and proposed remediation works are agreed in order to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Contamination – procedure for unexpected contamination or imported soils
conditions.text:
If remediation is unable to proceed in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy, or where significant unexpected contamination is encountered, or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately and operations on the affected part of the site shall cease. An amended or new Remediation Strategy and/or Soil Importation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any further remediation works which shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the revised approved Strategy. Prior to the site being brought into use, where significant unexpected contamination is not encountered, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing of such.

To ensure that any necessary remediation works are identified to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Contamination – remediation and verification reports before occupation
conditions.text:
Remediation works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy. On completion of those works, the Verification Report(s) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the approved programme. The site or phase of a site shall not be brought into use until such time as all verification information has been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that the remediation works are fully implemented as agreed and the site has been demonstrated to be 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Cycle parking details to be approved before superstructure works and provided before occupation
conditions.text:
Notwithstanding the approved details, works above the ground floor slab level shall not commence until full details of cycle parking and facilities have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved cycle parking and facilities shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

In the interests of highway safety and promoting sustainable travel opportunities.

conditions.summary: Vehicle areas to be laid out, surfaced and drained before occupation
conditions.text:
Development shall not be occupied until all areas shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles, including roads, footpaths, cycletracks, loading and servicing areas and vehicle parking space have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that loose materials and surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter.

To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Construction Management Plan (routing, mud prevention, dust control) before commencement
conditions.text:
Development shall not commence until a statement of construction practice has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the Statement of Construction Practice shall include full details of:
a) The construction vehicle routing, means of access, location of site compound, storage and parking (including workforce parking), means of loading and unloading of all contractors' plant, equipment, materials and vehicles and associated traffic management measures.
b) Methods to prevent mud, grit and dirt being carried on to the public highway from the development hereby approved.
c) Measures to control the emissions of dust and dirt during construction.
d) How the statement of construction practice will be made publicly available by the developer.
The approved details shall be implemented at the commencement of works on site and shall thereafter be retained and employed until completion of the works on site.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points details to be approved and installed before occupation
conditions.text:
The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until full details and a scheme for provision of Electric Vehicle Charging Points, cable enabled spaces and associated infrastructure have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development, retained and maintained thereafter as approved for the lifetime of the development.

In the interest of promoting low carbon transport.

conditions.summary: Bin store details to be approved and installed before occupation
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details for the provision of bin stores (including siting, materials and means of enclosure) and (where applicable) storage of wastes and access for their collection shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved measures shall be implemented in full before the use commences and shall be retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

To ensure adequate measures for the storage and collection of wastes are put in place for highway safety.

conditions.summary: Service yard and turning area to remain unobstructed for lifetime of development
conditions.text:
The service yard and turning area as shown on approved plan ref (561)2413-GWP-01-00-D-A-(PA)-0002 P04 shall remain free from any obstruction including the entirety of the area required for access and turning of large articulated lorries. This shall remain in place and managed as such for the lifetime of the development.

In the interest of highway safety and to ensure access required for large lorries.

conditions.summary: Accessible lift to be installed before first-floor office is occupied
conditions.text:
The first-floor of the office shall not be occupied or brought into use as an office, storage or any other purposes ancillary to the B2/B8 main use of the building until the approved accessible lift set out in drawing ref: '(561)2413-GWP-01-ZZ-D-A-(PA)-0008 rev: P05' is installed and brought into use. The accessible lift facilities shall be implemented, retained and maintained thereafter as approved for the lifetime of the development.

In the interests of supporting accessible provision and addressing inequalities to be compliant with Accessible Leeds SPD and Policy P10(vi) of the Leeds Core Strategy.

conditions.summary: Renewable energy / BREEAM Excellent certificate required before occupation
conditions.text:
Development shall not be occupied until full details and specification relating to renewable energy sources and technologies, as indicated in submitted supplementary information ref: Policy EN4 statement (05.04.2025) and BREEAM pre-assessment summary report (29.05.2025), has been assessed and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development is required to secure a BREEAM excellent certificate in order to comply with policy EN2.

In the interests of supporting sustainable development and carbon emissions reduction.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping details to be approved and implemented before occupation
conditions.text:
The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works, including an implementation programme, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Hard landscape layout plans and annotated cross sections including dimensions, colours, materials, construction etc. detailing: (a) boundary treatments, (b) types of hard surfacing, (c) minor artefacts and structures. Soft landscape details including: (d) planting plans for trees, hedges, meadow areas etc, (e) written specifications and (f) schedules of trees noting species, planting sizes and proposed numbers/densities. All hard and soft landscaping works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details, approved implementation programme and British Standard BS 4428:1989.

To ensure the provision and establishment of acceptable landscaping and visual amenity.

conditions.summary: Replacement tree planting within five years if any tree is removed, destroyed or dies
conditions.text:
If within a period of five years from the date of the planting of any tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective, another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted in the same location as soon as reasonably possible and no later than the first available planting season, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure maintenance of a healthy and visually effective landscape scheme.

conditions.summary: Protection of retained trees for five years; replacement planting if damaged
conditions.text: Within 5 years of first use of the development hereby approved, no approved retained trees shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any tree be pruned, topped or lopped or suffer root severance (other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars). In the event of any such works being carried out without having first sought and received written approval from the LPA the following actions shall be undertaken: (a) Within one month of the removal, uprooting, damage or loss of any retained tree, a replacement planting scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA... (b) Within one month of a pruning, topping, lopping or root severance of a retained tree, a Professional Arboricultural Report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA. In the interests of the character and amenities of the area, the best interests of nature conservation and bio-diversity.

conditions.summary: Tree and vegetation protective fencing in place before any works commence
conditions.text: No works shall commence (including any demolition, site clearance, groundworks or drainage etc.) until all existing trees, hedges and vegetation shown to be retained on the approved plans are fully safeguarded by protective fencing and ground protection in accordance with the approved Tree and Habitat Protection Plan (Dwg. No. RHS004_LTHT_P_104) received on the 6th December 2024 and the specifications and the provisions of British Standard 5837 (2012) Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction. Exclusion zones shall be clearly signposted to ensure access is prohibited and shall be retained for the entirety of the construction phase. Such measures shall be retained for the full duration of any demolition and/or approved works. To ensure the protection and preservation of landscaping and other natural features that make a positive contribution to the character and amenities of the area and to wider climate change and air pollution objectives.

conditions.summary: Landscape management plan to be submitted and approved before first use
conditions.text: A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to first use of the development hereby approved. The Management Plan must conform to Leeds City Council's Landscape Management Plans and associated checklist. The management plan shall thereafter be implemented within the first available planting season and carried out in accordance with the approved details. To ensure successful aftercare of landscaping and to achieve biodiversity net gain.

conditions.summary: Construction practice statement required before development commences
conditions.text: Development shall not commence until a statement of construction practice has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the statement of construction practice shall include full details of: a) the construction vehicle routing, means of access, location of site compound, storage and parking (including workforce parking), means of loading and unloading of all contractors' plant, equipment, materials and vehicles and associated traffic management measures. b) methods to prevent mud, grit and dirt being carried on to the public highway from the development hereby approved. The approved details shall be implemented at the commencement of works on site and shall thereafter be retained and employed until completion of the works on site.

conditions.summary: Unexpected contamination: notification, remediation strategy and verification required
conditions.text: The Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately where unexpected significant contamination is encountered during any development works and operations in the affected part of the site shall cease. Where remediation of unexpected significant contamination is considered by the Local Planning Authority to be necessary, a Remediation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the recommencement of development on the affected part of the site. The Remediation Strategy shall include a programme for all remediation works and for the provision of verification information. Remediation works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy. To enable the Local Planning Authority to ensure that unexpected contamination at the site will be addressed appropriately and that the development will be 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Imported soils to be tested for contamination before use on site
conditions.text: Any soil or soil forming materials brought to site for use in garden areas, soft landscaping, public open space or for filling and level raising shall be tested for contamination and suitability for use. A methodology for testing these soils shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to these materials being imported onto site. The methodology shall include information on the source of the materials, sampling frequency, testing schedules and criteria against which the analytical results will be assessed (as determined by risk assessment). Testing shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved methodology. Relevant evidence, assessment and verification information shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the site or phase of the site being brought into use.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in the Plans and Specifications above. For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

conditions.summary: External materials as shown on approved elevations plan
conditions.text: The building works shall be constructed from the materials as shown on Proposed Building Elevations Plan, ref: 2338/05E. In the interests of visual amenity.

conditions.summary: Revised plans with 2.1m easement and drainage strategy
conditions.text: Works shall be undertaken in accordance with the revised plans as outlined in 2338-08A. REV. PROPOSED BUILDING PLANS. 03 MARCH 2025, maintaining a 2.1m easement at all levels submitted, and the drainage strategy accepted in the original application 22/02393/FU. To ensure sustainable drainage and flood prevention in accordance with NRWLP policy Water 7 and GP5 of the UDP.

conditions.summary: Cycle/motorcycle parking details approved before above-slab works
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the approved details, works above the ground floor slab level shall not commence until full details of cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development. In the interests of highway safety and promoting sustainable travel opportunities.

conditions.summary: Vehicle areas surfaced and drained before occupation
conditions.text: Development shall not be occupied until all areas shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles, including roads, footpaths, cycle tracks, loading and servicing areas and vehicle parking space have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that loose materials and surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter. To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Statement of construction practice required before commencement
conditions.text: Development shall not commence until a statement of construction practice has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the statement of construction practice shall include full details of: a) the construction vehicle routing, means of access, location of site compound, storage and parking (including workforce parking), means of loading and unloading of all contractors' plant, equipment, materials and vehicles and associated traffic management measures. b) methods to prevent mud, grit and dirt being carried on to the public highway. c) measures to control the emissions of dust and dirt during construction. d) how the statement of construction practice will be made publicly available by the developer.

conditions.summary: Off-site highway works to be delivered before occupation
conditions.text: Prior to occupation of the development, the off-site highway works as shown in principle on plan 2338-07B comprising an access point with dropped kerb, reinstatement of any redundant dropped kerbs to full height footway and provision of 1.8m wide footway along the entire site frontage at Evanston Avenue shall be fully delivered. To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points provided before occupation
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until the approved Electric Vehicle Charging Points, cable enabled spaces and associated infrastructure have been provided. The facilities shall thereafter be retained and maintained as approved for the lifetime of the development. In the interest of promoting low carbon transport.

conditions.summary: Bin store provision implemented before use commences
conditions.text: The approved details for the provision of bin stores (including siting, materials and means of enclosure) and (where applicable) storage of wastes and access for their collection shall be implemented in full before the use commences and shall be retained thereafter as such for the lifetime of the development. In the interests of amenity and to ensure adequate measures for the storage and collection of wastes are put in place.

conditions.summary: Landscaping carried out in accordance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with details on plans ref: 2338/07A Proposed Site Plan, PWP-766-001 03 Outline Landscape Masterplan and maintained in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development. To ensure the provision and establishment of acceptable landscaping.

conditions.summary: Landscape management plan submitted before occupation
conditions.text: A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the development. The Management Plan must conform to Leeds City Council's Landscape Management Plans (Landscape Guidance No.2) and associated checklist. The landscape management plan shall be for the lifetime of the development and shall be carried out as approved. To ensure successful aftercare of landscaping.

conditions.summary: Biodiversity assessment and ecological management plans before development
conditions.text: No development shall take place until bio-diversity assessment and ecological management plans, including long-term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all landscaped areas has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. These plans shall include: (a) a lighting strategy for minimising light spill onto the river during construction works; (b) a lighting strategy for the permanent development; (c) details of new habitat created on-site; (d) details of habitat management of the riverbank; (e) details of management responsibilities. To ensure the protection of wildlife and supporting habitat and to secure opportunities for enhancing the site's nature conservation value in line with national planning policy and adopted policy G9 of the Leeds Core Strategy (as amended 2019).

conditions.summary: Removal of plastic tarpaulin from river bank before development
conditions.text: Prior to development of the site, the plastic tarpaulin, as identified in the Ecological Assessment, on the river bank, shall be removed from site. To ensure the protection of wildlife and supporting habitat. Also, to secure opportunities for enhancing the site's nature conservation value in line with national planning policy and adopted policy G9 of the Leeds Core Strategy (as amended 2019).

conditions.summary: Phase II site investigation and remediation strategy before commencement
conditions.text: Development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Phase II Site Investigation Report has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where remediation measures are shown to be necessary in the Phase II Report and/or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Remediation Strategy demonstrating how the site will be made suitable for the intended use has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. To ensure that the presence of contamination is identified, risks assessed and proposed remediation works are agreed in order to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Notification and amended remediation strategy if unexpected contamination found
conditions.text: If remediation is unable to proceed in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy, or where significant unexpected contamination is encountered, or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately and operations on the affected part of the site shall cease. An amended or new Remediation Strategy and/or Soil Importation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any further remediation works. To ensure that any necessary remediation works are identified to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Remediation works carried out per approved strategy with verification report
conditions.text: Remediation works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy. On completion of those works, the Verification Report(s) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the approved programme. The site or phase of a site shall not be brought into use until such time as all verification information has been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. To ensure that the remediation works are fully implemented as agreed and the site has been demonstrated to be 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.text:

Samples shall be made available on site prior to the commencement of building works, for inspection by the Local Planning Authority which shall be notified in writing of their availability. The building works shall be constructed from the materials thereby approved.

conditions.summary: Cycle/motorcycle parking details required prior to above ground works

Works above the ground floor slab level shall not commence until full details of cycle/motorcycle parking and facilities have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. conditions.summary: Vehicle areas to be laid out, surfaced and drained prior to occupation
conditions.text:
Development shall not be occupied until all areas shown on the approved plans to be used by vehicles, including roads, footpaths, cycle tracks, loading and servicing areas and vehicle parking space have been fully laid out, surfaced and drained such that loose materials and surface water does not discharge or transfer onto the highway. These areas shall not be used for any other purpose thereafter.

To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.

conditions.summary: Construction Environmental Management Plan (Statement of Construction Practice) required pre-commencement
conditions.text: Development shall not commence until a statement of construction practice has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the statement of construction practice shall include full details of: a) the construction vehicle routing, means of access, location of site compound, storage and parking (including workforce parking), means of loading and unloading of all contractors' plant, equipment, materials and vehicles and associated traffic management measures. b) methods to prevent mud, grit and dirt being carried on to the public highway. c) measures to control the emissions of dust and dirt during construction. d) how the statement of construction practice will be made publicly available by the developer. The approved details shall be implemented at the commencement of works on site and shall thereafter be retained and employed until completion of the works on site.

conditions.summary: Coal mining risk – intrusive site investigations and remediation prior to above-ground works
conditions.text:
No above ground development shall commence until; a) a scheme of intrusive investigations has been carried out on site to establish the risks posed to the development by past shallow coal mining activity; and b) any remediation works and/or mitigation measures to address land instability arising from past coal mining legacy, as may be necessary, have been implemented on site in full in order to ensure that the site is made safe and stable for the development proposed. The intrusive site investigations, remedial works and mitigatory measures shall be carried out in accordance with authoritative UK guidance.

Reason: The application site falls within the defined Development High Risk Area and to comply with the requirements of the NPPF.

conditions.summary: Coal mining risk – signed verification statement required prior to occupation
conditions.text:
Prior to the occupation of the development, or it being taken into beneficial use, a signed statement or declaration prepared by a suitably competent person confirming that the site is, or has been made, safe and stable for the approved development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. This document shall confirm the methods and findings of the intrusive site investigations and the completion of any remedial works and/or mitigation necessary to address the risks posed by past coal mining activity.

Reason: The application site falls within the defined Development High Risk Area and to comply with the requirements of the NPPF.

conditions.summary: Ground gas monitoring and revised Ground Gas Risk Assessment required pre-commencement
conditions.text:
Development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a report presenting the findings of the ground gas monitoring and a revised Ground Gas Risk Assessment (GGRA) has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. Where remediation measures are shown to be necessary in the revised GGRA, development (excluding demolition) shall not commence until a Remediation Strategy demonstrating how the site will be made suitable for the intended use has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The Remediation Strategy shall include a programme for all works and for the provision of Verification Reports.

To ensure that any ground gas risks associated with coal mining legacy are identified and assessed, and that proposed remediation works are agreed in order to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to mine gas risk.

conditions.summary: Contamination – notification and amended remediation strategy if unexpected contamination encountered
conditions.text:
If remediation is unable to proceed in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy, or where significant unexpected contamination is encountered, or where soil or soil forming material is being imported to site, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified in writing immediately and operations on the affected part of the site shall cease. An amended or new Remediation Strategy and/or Soil Importation Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any further remediation works which shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the revised approved Strategy.

To ensure that any necessary remediation works are identified to make the site 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Contamination – remediation works and verification report required before site brought into use
conditions.text:
Remediation works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Strategy. On completion of those works, the Verification Report(s) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the approved programme. The site or phase of a site shall not be brought into use until such time as all verification information has been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that the remediation works are fully implemented as agreed and the site has been demonstrated to be 'suitable for use' with respect to land contamination.

conditions.summary: Tree and hedge protection – BS5837 fencing, AMS and no-dig zones required pre-commencement
conditions.text:
a) No works shall commence until all existing trees, hedges, bushes shown to be retained on the approved plans are fully safeguarded by protective fencing and ground protection in accordance with approved plans and BS5837 (2012), unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. b) No works or development shall commence until a written Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS), including an annotated plan drawing showing all tree protection measures, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. c) No equipment, machinery or materials shall be used, stored or burnt within any protected area. d) Seven days written notice shall be given to the Local Planning Authority that the protection measures are in place prior to demolition and/or approved works.

To ensure the protection and preservation of trees, hedges, bushes and other natural features.

conditions.summary: Integral bat roosting and bird nesting features plan required pre-commencement
conditions.text:
Prior to the commencement of development, a Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority of: integral bat roosting and integral bird nesting features (for species such as House Sparrow and Swift) within buildings. Features that are not integral will only be considered for approval if an appropriately qualified ecologist provides assurance that integral features are not possible. The agreed Plan shall show the number, specification and location of features, together with a timetable for implementation. All approved features shall be installed prior to first occupation and retained in the manner as approved thereafter.

Reason: to maintain and enhance biodiversity in accordance with Core Strategy Policy G9, NPPF, and BS 42020:2013.

conditions.summary: Landscape and Biodiversity Net Gain Management Plan (min. 0.19 Habitat Units) required pre-commencement
conditions.text:
Prior to the commencement of development, a Landscape and Biodiversity Net Gain Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The Plan shall deliver a minimum of 0.19 Habitat Units; on land identified in the Headline Results for On-site Post-Intervention in the Biodiversity Accounting Assessment Report and include details of: a) Baseline Metric calculations; b) Extent/location of proposed features on scaled maps; c) Ecological trends and constraints; d) Aims and Objectives including Target Biodiversity Units; e) Appropriate management Actions; f) A dated Annual Work Programme (initial 5 years); g) Details of specialist ecological management body; h) Funding confirmation; i) Annual progress reports for first 5 years; j) Habitat monitoring in years 1, 3, 5, 10, 20 and 30; k) Contingency provisions; l) Plan reviewed every 5 years for lifetime of development.

Reason: to ensure the long-term protection and enhancement of biodiversity in accordance with Core Strategy Policy G8 and G9, NPPF and BS 42020:2013.

conditions.summary: Drainage works to be carried out in accordance with submitted Drainage Documentation
conditions.text:
Drainage works shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Drainage Documentation dated (25 April 2025).

To ensure sustainable drainage and flood prevention in accordance with NRWLP policy Water 7 and GP5 of the UDP.

In the interest of preserving the heritage significance of the building.

conditions.summary: Full construction details of door proposals for existing WCs and Stores (rooms 13–17, 56)

conditions.summary: Development to be carried out in accordance with approved Phasing Plan
conditions.text: The Phases of the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Development Phasing Plan Document 042/Rev E, unless otherwise approved in writing by the local planning authority, and any reference to `phase` or `phases` in the conditions below shall refer to the phases detailed in the plan thereby approved.

conditions.summary: Off-site highway works to be fully delivered prior to occupation of each phase
conditions.text:
Prior to occupation of a phase of the development, the off-site highway works relevant to that phase as shown on plan 24-299-SKH-005 rev F and comprising the following:
Phase 1 (Student living, building 2) ; modification of access point Lisbon St; TRO to prevent loading on Lisbon St; car club including TRO and markings; resurfacing footways Lisbon Street and Castle St.
Phase 2 (Build to rent, building 1) - widening footway on Little Queen St, loading bay at Little Queen St and TRO for loading bay, shared use walking/cycle route A58 (eastern part), delivery of A58 screen (eastern part).
Phase 3 (Hotel, building 3) - modification of access on Castle Street; resurfacing footway castle St; service road access including bollards.
shall be fully delivered.
Within 6 months prior to first occupation of Phase 1(building 2), the western part of the shared use walking/cycle route A58 and western part of A58 screen shall be fully delivered. To ensure the free and safe use of the highway.
